name: Xiaoyi OAuth
description: Reuse the signed-in XiaoyiWork desktop app's local OpenAI-compatible model proxy. Windows only; the proxy key is decrypted in memory via registry + DPAPI and never written to disk.
author: WenPaul

zh-CN.description: 把已登录的小艺Work 桌面端本地模型代理接入 CLIProxyAPI。Windows 专用；proxyKey 通过注册表 + DPAPI 在内存内解密，不落盘。自动补齐标准 OpenAI 流式分帧、[DONE]、工具调用合并与 usage。
